title: Zetta's can't-be-attacked stays after Zetta dies
summary: I played the Order champion that makes my other champions unattackable. After it died, my other champions were still unattackable for the rest of the game.
expected: Once the champion granting the aura leaves play, the protection should end.
repro: Play Zetta the Encryptor (you + other champions can't be attacked)
Try to attack my other champions — still blocked
rawText: the champion that protects my other champions kept protecting them even after it died
